channel.title: GTA6Touch
channel.description: Walkthroughs, the Leonida map and checklists you can tick off while you play GTA 6.

item.title: GTA 6 Cheats: All 61 Cheats, Codes and How to Unlock Them
item.description: Every GTA 6 cheat: all 61 cheats with their unlock tasks, the 21 button codes confirmed so far for PS5 and Xbox, and how to enter them.

item.title: GTA 6 Mission List and Walkthrough Hub
item.description: The GTA 6 mission list in story order: the Prologue and Chapter 1 missions, with 93 walkthroughs so far and more added as each mission is verified.

item.title: GTA 6 Cars: Full Vehicle List and How to Keep a Car
item.description: Every GTA 6 car named by launch guides, sorted by class, plus the bikes, boats and aircraft, the edition vehicles and how to steal, register and keep a car.

item.title: GTA 6 Map: All Confirmed Regions of Leonida
item.description: Where GTA 6 is set and every region Rockstar has confirmed: Vice City, Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia and Mount Kalaga.

item.title: GTA 6 100% Completion: Full Checklist and Reward
item.description: GTA 6 100 completion explained: the 35 checklist requirements with counts, what you can skip, what cannot be missed, and the reward for finishing it.

item.title: GTA 6 Collectibles: Every Type, How Many, and What They Unlock
item.description: All GTA 6 collectibles in one place: 480 collectible cards, 125 cocaine flamingos, 34 watches, WAiNK scans and more, with counts and what each unlocks.

item.title: GTA 6 Gone Fishing Walkthrough: Mission 2 Step by Step
item.description: GTA 6 Gone Fishing walkthrough: collect the packages by boat, get through the camp quietly, win the fist fight and fly the seaplane back to the marina.

item.title: GTA 6 Prologue Walkthrough: The First Mission Step by Step
item.description: GTA 6 Prologue walkthrough: every objective of the first mission, the controls it teaches, where guides disagree about the chase, and what comes next.

item.title: Vice City in GTA 6: Districts and What to Expect
item.description: Vice City returns in GTA 6 as the main city of Leonida. What Rockstar has confirmed about its beaches, nightlife, businesses and place on the map.

item.title: GTA 6 Wanted Level Explained: Six Stars and Heat
item.description: How the GTA 6 wanted level works: six stars, red heat icons that show what the police know, hot areas, and how to lose the cops in Leonida.

item.title: How to Make Money in GTA 6: Best Methods by Chapter
item.description: How to make money in GTA 6 without cheats: selling stolen cars, store and jewelry robberies, bank vaults and side activities, and when each one unlocks.

item.title: Port Gellhorn in GTA 6: Location Guide
item.description: Port Gellhorn in GTA 6 is a faded coastal town on Leonida's forgotten coast. Where it is, what Rockstar has shown and what to do there.

item.title: GTA 6 Characters: Every Confirmed Name
item.description: All GTA 6 characters confirmed by Rockstar: protagonists Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos, plus Cal Hampton, Boobie Ike, Raul Bautista and more.

item.title: Jason Duval in GTA 6: Everything Confirmed
item.description: Who Jason Duval is in GTA 6: his Army past, his work for drug runners in the Leonida Keys, his friends and his relationship with Lucia.

item.title: Lucia Caminos in GTA 6: Everything Confirmed
item.description: Who Lucia Caminos is in GTA 6: her backstory, her relationship with Jason, why she was in prison and what Rockstar has confirmed about her.
